declare "mta_filter" {

    argument "logfilename" {}
    argument "log_receiver" {}

    loki.source.file "mta" {
        targets               = [{__path__ = argument.logfilename.value, "job" = "mta"}]
        forward_to            = [loki.process.mta.receiver]
                tail_from_end = true
    }

    loki.process "mta" {
        forward_to = [loki.relabel.mta_drop_label.receiver]
        stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2}).(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3}).(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<sev>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\\([^)]*\\)\\s(?P<desc1>[^:]+):(?P<desc2>[^:]+):(?<kv_data>.*)$"
        }

        stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2}).(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3}).(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<sev>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\\([^)]*\\)\\s(?P<ops>[^:]+):(?<kv_data>.*)$"
        }

        // Get date in format
        stage.template {
            source = "formatted_date"
            template = "{{.year}}-{{.month}}-{{.day}}T{{.hour}}:{{.min}}:{{.sec}}.{{.ms}}+{{.timezone}}:00"
        }
        stage.timestamp {
            source = "formatted_date"
            format = "2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z07:00"
            action_on_failure = "skip"
        }

        stage.labels {
            values = {
                event = "",
                ops = "",
            }
        }

        stage.match {
           selector = "{event!~\"MsgTrace|FiltActionConflict|MtaMessageForwardChain|MtaServerFailed|MtaSenderRejected|SmtpDnsBadConfig\"}"
           action = "drop"
           drop_counter_reason = "non_essential_log"
        }

        stage.match {
           selector = "{ops!~\".*(deferred|delivered|forwarded|received|bounced|MtaSenderRejected|MtaHostInvalid|).*\", event=~\"MtaMessageForwardChain|MtaServerFailed|MtaSenderRejected|SmtpDnsBadConfig\"}"
           action = "drop"
           drop_counter_reason = "non_essential_log"
        }

      // Drop non-essential MsgTrace events
        stage.match {
           selector = "{event=\"MsgTrace\", ops=~\".*(enqueueMsg|Successfully rescheduled message with).*\"}"
           action = "drop"
           drop_counter_reason = "non_essential_log"
        }

        stage.replace {
             source    = "kv_data"
             expression = "(:)"
             replace   = " "
        }

        stage.template {
            source = "kv_data"
            template = `
                {{- regexReplaceAll "([A-Za-z]+)=([^ ]+)" .kv_data "${1}=\"${2}\"" -}}
            `
        }

        stage.replace {
            source     = "kv_data"
            expression = "(\\\\)"
            replace    = "\\\\\\\\"
        }

        stage.logfmt {
            source = "kv_data"
            mapping = {
                user = "user",
                mbox = "mbox",
                mss = "mss",
                from = "from",
                msgid = "msgid",
                size = "size",
                cmd = "cmd",
                desthost = "desthost",
                fromhost = "fromhost",
                fromport = "fromport",
                sid = "sid",
                msgfile = "msgfile",
                sender = "sender",
                rcpts = "rcpts",
                auth = "auth",
                port = "port",
                docid = "docid",
                node = "node",
                nodePort = "nodePort",
                rcptCosId = "rcptCosId",
            }
        }

        stage.template {
            source = "output"
            template = "{\"hostname\":\"{{ .hostname }}\"" +
                        ",\"event\":\"{{ .event }}\"" +
                        ",\"sev\":\"{{ .sev }}\"" +
                        ",\"ops\":\"{{ .ops }}\"" +
                        ",\"thread_id\":\"{{ .thread_id }}\"" +
                        "{{ if .user }},\"user\":\"{{ .user }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .mbox }},\"mbox\":\"{{ .mbox }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .mss }},\"mss\":\"{{ .mss }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .from }},\"from\":\"{{ .from }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .msgid }},\"msgid\":\"{{ .msgid }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .size }},\"size\":{{ .size }}{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .cmd }},\"cmd\":\"{{ .cmd }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .desthost }},\"desthost\":\"{{ .desthost }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .fromhost }},\"fromhost\":\"{{ .fromhost }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .fromport }},\"fromport\":\"{{ .fromport }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .sid }},\"sid\":\"{{ .sid }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .msgfile }},\"msgfile\":\"{{ .msgfile }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .sender }},\"sender\":\"{{ .sender }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .rcpts }},\"rcpts\":\"{{ .rcpts }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .auth }},\"auth\":\"{{ .auth }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .port }},\"port\":\"{{ .port }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .docid }},\"docid\":\"{{ .docid }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .node }},\"node\":\"{{ .node }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .nodePort }},\"nodePort\":\"{{ .nodePort }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "{{ if .rcptCosId }},\"rcptCosId\":\"{{ .rcptCosId }}\"{{ end }}" +
                        "}"
        }

                // Email bucket for user, rcpts, sender and from
        // Domain matching is case-insensitive
        stage.template {
            source = "bucket_tmp"
            template = `
               {{- if .user -}}

                   {{- if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .user) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .user) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .user) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .user) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .user) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .user) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else -}}
                       common
                   {{- end -}}

               {{- else if .rcpts -}}

                   {{- if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .rcpts) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .rcpts) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else -}}
                       common
                   {{- end -}}

               {{- else if .sender -}}

                   {{- if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .sender) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .sender) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else -}}
                       common
                   {{- end -}}

               {{- else if .from -}}

                   {{- if contains "@btinternet.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@btopenworld.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                   {{- else if contains "@talk21.com" (ToLower .from) -}}
                       {{- $email := regexReplaceAll "^<|>$" (ToLower .from) "" -}}
                       {{- $username := index (splitList "@" $email) 0 -}}
                       {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t1|\\.t2)$" $username "" -}}
                       {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}

                   {{- else -}}
                       common
                   {{- end -}}

               {{- else -}}
                   common
               {{- end -}}
           `
        }

        stage.labels {
            values = {
                email_bucket = "bucket_tmp",
            }
        }

        stage.output {
            source = "output"
        }
    }
    loki.relabel "mta_drop_label" {
       rule {
           action = "labeldrop"
           regex  = "filename|fromhost|cmd|ops"
       }
       forward_to = argument.log_receiver.value
    }
}
